resources.string: Choose battery saving for low-power location requests targeting about 10 km accuracy, or high precision for GPS-level requests using more battery. Neither guarantees a fix or accuracy. Records are sent promptly using the latest available position, clearly marked if it is last known or unavailable. Manual capture keeps its current high-accuracy request.

Previously started saving resumes when this app is reopened, including after force-stop or returning from permission/battery settings. Stop tracking keeps it off. If Android kills the process, changing settings alone may not restart it until you reopen the app or another permitted recovery event occurs.
Android and phone battery controls can delay saving. Use the system settings to allow background activity if needed. This app does not hold a permanent wake lock or use an alarm watchdog.

Android requires this app to post a foreground-service notification for continuous location saving. It is quiet by default. System settings control its visibility; some phones let you hide this channel. Android may still show system privacy or running-app indicators.
